scope: Matched additive measured-feature ablation, not TRAIN-support expansion or blind qualification
physical_cases: Same48 cached8s ordinary-mixture trajectories,2 schedule replicates and cross/stable/retreat profiles; no new simulation
gate: Existing command-free finite unsaturated window and original64-to64 forecast skill >=.5; no new gate, truth routing, stale policy or row removal
base_features: All174 retained. Canonical original clean/IID1 feature rows reused exactly for baseline reproducibility; other original views from source comparison; fresh views extracted once identically for all arms

spectral: union neighborhood mass around existing top3 fitted-strength frequencies,nearest bin +/-1,lower tie,clipped1..63
append_definition.invalid: NaN in stored descriptors plus explicit validity. Training-only mean imputation to standardized0 with validity flags; never invent measurement or drop a row
append_definition.validity_encoding: Raw binary flags, not variance scaled; invalid values standardized0; every unobserved row has zero appended inputs.

negative_controls: Shuffle appended values jointly across physical trajectories within each split, same permutation across paired acquisition views; preserve original row-validity flags. Fixed seed20261009; no labels used. Matched dimensions/learner capacity. Negative controls do not represent deployable models Permutation acts on training-mean-imputed standardized values; missing donors contribute standardized0, original target validity flags remain unshuffled. Original standardization is shared with the corresponding real family.

training.learner: framewise32->16 ReLU; only input columns differ
training.loss: Existing all-frame mean squared error on proper clean/IID1 trajectories, including original gap behavior
training.selection: Original clean/IID1 validation all-frame MAE only; no fresh-noise/held selection

evaluation.fresh_population: Same held physical trajectories only, no new designs or fitting on fresh noise
evaluation.noise: Existing original-eight aggregate causal prefixRMS sigma; same white draw for paired IID/correlated, rho=.8 and realized per-channel marginal RMS matched; never percent of decaying response

metrics: Equal-design all-frame/current/gap MAE, exact -.02<m<.05 boundary, optimism>.02, sign errors by side on.01<=abs(m)<=.05, descriptive positive-on-m<0, m>=.10 farther-stable; counts/unknown explicit; perseed/perdesign/profile/rate/margin bands

rate_strata.units: abs(dm/dt)/s from stored labels for scoring only

bin_transitions: Consecutive original accepted windows; any existing top3 nearest-bin change. Report paired signed/magnitude errors and prediction-jump residuals; no smoothing/retuning
decision: No adoption unless paired primary-condition overall/boundary gains on both held designs across seeds/freshdraws, dangerous errors and profile/rate/5%/farther-stable guardrails preserved; absence of coverage remains unresolved. Must outperform matched-size shuffled controls. No combination unless both individual families earn evidence
limits: Only4 fitting,2 validation,2 repeatedly inspected held TRAIN designs; no blind confirmation

No warning recalibration or supported safety claim
15 fixed model fits; no hyperparameter or feature search
